verdicts.reason: A fills the wide short canvas well: headline is large and bold, window large, and the details are legible and right-aligned in a clear left-to-right order. Flaws: the headline's 'Sunday' almost touches the window, the details block is jammed against the right edge, margins are tight and uneven, and the window is nearly clipped at top and bottom. B shrinks everything. Headline and details are tiny, and the details text is very small and thin. It leaves large dead space on all sides, with the cluster floating in the middle and a weak hierarchy. This is a shrunk copy of the original rather than a rearrangement.
